record.oneLiner: PitchBook Direct Data / API: a separately contracted add-on that issues API keys or authentication tokens through the Direct Data sales team.
record.verdictReason: PARTLY EVIDENCED (read by hand in a browser): the vendor pages confirm a REST API on all PitchBook entity types and a sales-led, pay-for-what-you-use model reached through a contact form. They do not state the auth method or any MCP server, so apiKey and existingMcp none are unconfirmed; the API reference sits behind a Morningstar login.

evidence.quote: Our RESTful API utilizes JSON and is system agnostic, so you can integrate it into custom applications and CRMs
Our team of experts will work with you to ensure your organization can bridge any gap of understanding
Choose the data that matters most to you and only pay for what you need.
